frequency_question: How often do declared indefinite strikes by major banking union federations actually commence on or before the specified deadline rather than being called off or indefinitely postponed?
membership_rule: Members include formal strike notices or calls by major banking union coalitions (such as UFBU or equivalent national bodies) specifying an indefinite duration and a strict calendar deadline. Excluded are local wildcat strikes, strikes lasting a fixed number of hours/days rather than indefinite, and non-banking sectors.
